_howToEdit: Each store below gets one card per flyer week on Discount Koi, linking to the store's own official flyer page.
Nothing from the flyer is copied: the card only says which week it is and links out.
store: name shown on the card. url: the store's official flyer (or weekly deals) page.
startsOn: weekday each new flyer begins (mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun). A card runs from that day until the day before the next flyer.
label: what the card calls it, e.g. 'weekly flyer' or 'weekly deals'.
category: one of grocery, food-restaurants, electronics, fashion, home, health-beauty, sports-outdoors, kids-baby, pets, automotive, entertainment, services, other.
The start days are best guesses. Check them against a real flyer and fix any that are off.
To add a store, copy one entry, change it, and keep the commas between entries.
